description: Capture every moment with the Lmzour 4K Digital Camera, designed for modern content creators, travelers, and everyday users. Featuring a unique 330° rotating lens, this compact camera makes it easy to record videos, live streams, and social media content with professional-looking results. Equipped with a 16MP SONY CMOS sensor and supporting up to 75MP photo resolution, this 4K vlogging camera delivers sharp images and smooth video recording at 30FPS. The fast PDAF autofocus and 79° wide-angle lens ensure clear, focused shots whether you're filming YouTube videos, TikTok clips, or capturing daily memories. Built for portability, this pocket-sized digital camera is lightweight and easy to carry anywhere. The 1.72-inch IPS touchscreen provides intuitive control, while built-in WiFi allows you to connect to your smartphone for instant sharing and remote shooting—perfect for travel, outdoor adventures, and spontaneous moments. Unlock your creativity with multiple shooting modes including time-lapse, slow motion, burst shooting, and interval recording.
